text: Bob Priddy and Rudi Keller of the Missouri Independent gave key election night updates on Nov. 3.

West Plains native Stan Utley was inducted into the Missouri Golf Hall of Fame, honoring his career as a professional golfer, instructor and junior golf advocate, Missouri Golf announced Oct. 26. Some people just have the swing for it.
Missouri Independent reporter Rudi Keller tracked campaign finance reports to show whose political action committees have the biggest punch in Missouri's final election push.
